_comment_server_url: This app is one Express process serving the API and dist/ from the same origin — auth is a same-origin httpOnly cookie and client/src/api.js calls relative '/api/...' URLs. Bundling a local copy of dist/ into the native shell would break both. Instead, once you have a Railway (or custom) domain, add a top-level "server": { "url": "https://your-domain", "cleartext": false } block here so the native WebView loads the real deployed site, the same way a browser would. Do this before `npx cap sync` for a build you intend to ship.
